name: anamnesis
description: Persistent memory for Claude Code — deterministic capture via lifecycle hooks. Per-user encrypted, visible, deletable. 0.3.3 fixes the date/time anchor: a subshell bug meant <server-time> had never fired once — every prompt now carries <current-datetime> with day-of-week, local timezone, and server UTC (local clock as offline fallback), unconditionally. 0.3.2 made Stop capture non-blocking and incremental (background worker, per-transcript high-water mark) and fixed ARG_MAX silent upload failures. OAuth 2.1 + PKCE + DCR via 'anamnesis-config'.
